about: The past in lagos, day by day since 2026-11-17: what IPMA's station Portimão (Aeródromo) (1210878) measured (low, high, rain; complete only when all 24 hours were seen) and what IPMA forecast for that day one, two and three days before (d1, d2, d3), as published. A null is a day or forecast we do not have: never filled in. Collections before 18 November 2026 were not kept.
